items.why: Retired Claude Haiku 3.5 rows were dropped from the docs pricing tables; no price changed on any listed model, and a web search error-billing sentence was reworded.
Linux build machines on the paid tiers get bigger: 2 vCPU / 8GB becomes up to 4 vCPU / 16GB, and 4 vCPU / 16GB becomes up to 8 vCPU / 32GB, with no price change.

record.short: Linux machine size on the paid tiers rises from 2 vCPU / 8GB to up to 4 vCPU / 16GB, and from 4 vCPU / 16GB to up to 8 vCPU / 32GB, at unchanged prices.

items.why: Feature list was reorganised and relabelled (Lookbook, wallet, Pay subs and suppliers); no price or tier change.
AI add-on renamed from AI Super Credits to AI Credits; the $10 per 10K credits price is unchanged.
Navigation menu gained North Capabilities links; no pricing content changed.
Premium feature copy renamed (Goals to Future, Hidden Gems to Weekly Insights) with punctuation edits; the $49 a month price is unchanged.
Event promotion banner added at the top of the page.
Testimonial quote punctuation and one FAQ answer on cancelling were added; no pricing change.
The tracing retention row was renamed from Session Tracing to Trace Retention and its windows rose from 1 hour, 1 day and 3 days to 3 days and 14 days.

record.short: Trace retention rises from 1 hour, 1 day and 3 days of traces to 3 days and 14 days of traces, with no price change.

items.why: A new Volumes storage meter ($0.16 GB/month) and new model rows were added to the sandboxes and Model APIs pricing; no existing price changed.
The DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 model row was removed from the model list; no price change on other models.
Navigation menu items were rearranged.
Footer links were relabelled.
Navigation menu gained featured model endpoint links.
Typo fix in the Smart Disputes fee sentence; the 30% fee is unchanged.

The Team Cloud Plan was replaced by a new Team Cloud Plan card at $85.50 /mo (was $217 /mo) with 1 paid seat and 3 KxAI Seats, 3 GB vector storage instead of 4 GB, and 50 shared map viewers instead of 5; the Business Cloud and Enterprise cards no longer appear in the plan cards.

record.short: Team Cloud Plan is restructured from $217 /mo with 2 paid seats and 4 GB vector storage to $85.50 /mo with 1 paid seat, 3 KxAI Seats and 3 GB vector storage.

items.why: Test analytics moved from the list billed by test atoms evaluated to the list of features free on every plan, while dynamic parallelism joined the billed list.

record.short: Test analytics moves from billed by test atoms evaluated to free on every plan, and dynamic parallelism is added to the billed Smarter Testing features.

items.why: Per-model credit cost descriptions for video and image generation were removed from the page text; no plan price changed.
The page was redesigned and condensed; browser, proxy, model and concurrency rates read the same as before.
Top announcement banner text changed.
Form button label changed from Submit to Next.
Photo RAW MAX yearly subscription is now shown at $79.99/year with $89.99 as the struck-through price, the same sale display used on the one-time purchase prices.

promo.text: Photo RAW MAX yearly subscription shown at $79.99/year, down from $89.99

items.why: Free plan tagline reworded and the Vertical Landing Page blueprint dropped from the template lists; no price or limit change.
A Build a plan configurator was added to the Growth plan; the existing $49 / $39 entry price is unchanged and the configurator prices are first-time displays.
Pro plan sync integration list now names GitHub Issues in place of Shortcut; most likely a copy change with no price or tier change.
Only the as-of date in the indicative rate footnote changed.
Brand Radar prompt database count updated from 531 million to 538 million; no price change.
Webinar banner added at the top of the page.
Product announcement banner added at the top of the page.
Product menu label renamed from Aiven DataHub to Aiven for DataHub.
The Reporting and Social Listening add-ons were merged into one Reports & Listening add-on at $79/mo, and the FAQ now says there are two Basic add-ons instead of three.

record.short: The Reporting and Social Listening add-ons for the Basic plan merge into one Reports & Listening add-on at $79/mo, leaving it and Social Inbox as the only add-ons; the page still shows Social Reports at $59 and Social Listening at $39 in the add-on cards.

items.why: A new beam model row was added to the usage pricing table; no existing price changed.
